description: BOKU University and SECURES research partners publish European meteorological inputs for electricity supply and demand modelling. SECURES-Met provides temperature, global and direct-normal radiation, wind-power potential and hydro-power potential aggregated to NUTS regions and offshore exclusive economic zones. Historical data cover 1981–2020, with hydro ending in 2010. RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 projections extend to 2100 from one specified EURO-CORDEX model, with variable-dependent start years. Temperature, radiation and wind are hourly; hydro is daily. CSV archives and geographic metadata are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. They can drive climate-sensitive capacity and dispatch studies using model-pypsa and relate to the historical input data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that two emissions scenarios do not constitute a climate-model ensemble. The authors recommend population-weighted temperature and radiation for their intended applications; spatial means serve as reference. No numerical files were downloaded or modelled.
